model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the absolute mean of the hidden state. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4.5, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A dashed blue line, labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”, begins at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, increases to a maximum of approximately 0.9 at layer 12, then declines to approximately 1.8 at layer 19, and rises sharply to approximately 4.2 at layer 21. A dotted orange line, labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”, remains relatively constant at approximately 0.04 across all layer values from 0 to 21. A solid green line, labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”, remains at approximately 0.04 across all layer values from 0 to 21.
